verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks that send real-time data to another system whenever a table event occurs, which covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. Realtime Postgres Changes offers a related client-side subscription path, but it is not webhook delivery. Missing for 10: webhooks for non-database events (e.g. auth or platform events), details on delivery guarantees, retries and payload signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
